copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把技术性的内容拆成大白话,按 who、what、where、why、when 几个角度讲清楚:它是什么、谁在用、在哪、为什么、什么时候用。
howto.when: 当你觉得某个东西太技术、想要一份大白话解释时,它会接管,从 who、what、where、why、when 讲起。

say.text: 这段代码太技术了,用大白话讲讲它是谁、是什么、在哪、为什么、什么时候用
say.note: Claude 按五个角度给出通俗解释

say.text: 用大白话解释一下 Kubernetes 是什么、谁在用、为什么用
say.note: 得到一份不含术语的解释

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude breaks technical things into plain English along the who, what, where, why, and when angles, so you learn what it is, who uses it, why, and when.
howto.when_en: It takes over when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — covering the who, what, where, why, and when.

say_en.text: Explain the who, what, where, why, and when of this in plain English
say_en.note: Claude gives a plain-English rundown along five angles

say_en.text: In plain English, what is Kubernetes, who uses it, and why?
